title: Ask nothing more of me, sweet. All I can give you I give.
html_source:
These are the first two lines of “the Oblation” by Algernon Charles Swinburne mentioned in a following annotation.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: It’s from the Bible. One of the apostles was accosted by a beggar for money but the apostle was broke then decided to heal him(a miracle). Sorry I forget the name of the apostle
